sloka: स तेन बाणैः प्रसभं निपातितैश्कार नादं घननादनिस्वनः ।समुत्पपाताशु नभः स मारुतिर्भुजोरुविक्षेपणघोरदर्शनः ।। ५.४७.२१।।।।
transliteration: sa tena bāṇaiḥ prasabhaṁ nipātitaiśkāra nādaṁ ghananādanisvanaḥ ।samutpapātāśu nabhaḥ sa mārutirbhujoruvikṣepaṇaghoradarśanaḥ ।। 5.47.21।।।।

translations.english: Struck by the arrows released by prince Aksha, Hanuman roared violently like a thundering cloud and leaped into the sky putting up a fierce appearance, stretching his arms and thighs.
